SELECT 
    "School", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)", 
    "SAT Participation", 
    "High Scorers (>=1500)"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.School, 
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
        f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
        ss.NumTstTakr AS "SAT Participation",
        ss.NumGE1500 AS "High Scorers (>=1500)"
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
        AND s."CDSCode" IN (
            SELECT 
                f2."CDSCode" 
            FROM 
                schools s2
            JOIN 
                frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
            WHERE 
                s2.SOC = '66'
            ORDER BY 
                f2."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
            LIMIT 5
        )
) AS top_schools
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC;

WITH TopSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School,
        f."School Code"
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode LIKE '%' || f."School Code" || '%'
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
    ORDER BY 
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 5
)

SELECT 
    ts.School,
    ts."School Code",
    ss.NumTstTakr,
    ss.AvgScrRead,
    ss.AvgScrMath,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    ss.NumGE1500,
    (ss.NumTstTakr / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "SAT Participation Rate (%)",
    (ss.NumGE1500 / ss.NumTstTakr) * 100 AS "High Scorer Rate (%)"
FROM 
    TopSchools ts
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON ts."School Code" = ss.cds
JOIN 
    frpm f ON ts."School Code" = f."School Code"
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC;

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        38 AS TotalSchools,
        0 AS TotalCharterSchools,
        15 AS HighFRPMSchools,
        1377.5 AS AvgTotalSATScore,
        2510.0 AS TotalFreeMeals,
        4588.0 AS TotalEnrollment
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        203 AS TotalSchools,
        18 AS TotalCharterSchools,
        56 AS HighFRPMSchools,
        1549.0588235294117 AS AvgTotalSATScore,
        8188.0 AS TotalFreeMeals,
        18236.0 AS TotalEnrollment
)
SELECT
    (colusa.TotalSchools / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
    (colusa.TotalCharterSchools / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
    (colusa.HighFRPMSchools / humboldt.HighFRPMSchools) AS HighFRPMSchoolRatio,
    (colusa.AvgTotalSATScore / humboldt.AvgTotalSATScore) AS SATScoreRatio,
    (colusa.TotalFreeMeals / humboldt.TotalFreeMeals) AS FreeMealRatio,
    (colusa.TotalEnrollment / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio
FROM
    colusa,
    humboldt;

sql:
SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    (SELECT 
         g.Country,
         g.GasStationID
     FROM 
         transactions_1k t
     JOIN 
         gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
     JOIN 
         (SELECT 
              g.Country,
              g.Segment,
              t.ProductID,
              AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
          FROM 
              transactions_1k t
          JOIN 
              gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
          GROUP BY 
              g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID) avg_prices
     ON 
         g.Country = avg_prices.Country 
         AND g.Segment = avg_prices.Segment 
         AND t.ProductID = avg_prices.ProductID
     WHERE 
         t.Price < avg_prices.AvgPrice
     GROUP BY 
         g.Country, g.GasStationID) value_for_money
GROUP BY 
    Country;

    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStationsCount

        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country

        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,

            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice

            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID

        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations

sql:
SELECT 
    Country, 
    ValueForMoneyGasStations
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            COUNT(DISTINCT t.GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStations
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        JOIN 
            (
                SELECT 
                    g.Country,
                    g.Segment,
                    t.ProductID,
                    AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
                FROM 
                    transactions_1k t
                JOIN 
                    gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
                GROUP BY 
                    g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
            ) a ON g.Country = a.Country AND g.Segment = a.Segment AND t.ProductID = a.ProductID
        WHERE 
            t.Price < a.AvgPrice
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country
    ) subquery
ORDER BY 
    ValueForMoneyGasStations DESC;

        SELECT 
            CustomerID,
            MAX(Consumption) AS MaxConsumption

            (
                SELECT 
                    c.CustomerID,
                    ym.Consumption
                FROM 
                    customers c

        GROUP BY 
            CustomerID
    ) AS max_consumption
ORDER BY 
    MaxConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) AS Month
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'SME'
) AND Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY Year, Month
HAVING SUM(Consumption) = (
    SELECT MAX(TotalConsumption)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM yearmonth
        WHERE CustomerID IN (
            SELECT CustomerID
            FROM customers
            WHERE Segment = 'SME'
        ) AND Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        GROUP BY SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4), SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2)
    ) AS MonthlyConsumption
);

WITH ValueForMoneyStations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.GasStationID,
        g.Country
    FROM 
        transactions_1k t
    JOIN 
        gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            g.Country,
            g.Segment,
            t.ProductID,
            AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        JOIN 
            gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
        GROUP BY 
            g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID
    ) ap ON g.Country = ap.Country AND g.Segment = ap.Segment AND t.ProductID = ap.ProductID
    WHERE 
        t.Price < ap.AvgPrice
)

SELECT 
    Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GasStationID) AS ValueForMoneyGasStationsCount
FROM 
    ValueForMoneyStations
GROUP BY 
    Country;

sql:
-- Percentage by region
SELECT region, 
       total_gold_cards_in_region,
       gold_cards_before_1998_in_region,
       (gold_cards_before_1998_in_region * 100.0 / total_gold_cards_in_region) AS percentage_before_1998
FROM (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards_in_region,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998_in_region
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY d.A3
) AS region_data;

-- Overall percentage
SELECT (SUM(gold_cards_before_1998_in_region) * 100.0 / SUM(total_gold_cards_in_region)) AS overall_percentage_before_1998
FROM (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards_in_region,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998_in_region
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    GROUP BY d.A3
) AS region_data;

SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS total_loans_table
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS no_issues_loans_table
     ON 
        total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
        AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category);

        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,

        SELECT

            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,

        FROM 
            client c
        JOIN 
            district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

            c.gender = 'F'
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

       COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards_in_region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998_in_region
FROM card c
JOIN disp dsp ON c.disp_id = dsp.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON dsp.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold'
GROUP BY d.A3;

WITH loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        dist.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        l.status,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        loan l
    JOIN 
        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
    WHERE 
        l.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        dist.A2, loan_size_category, l.status
),
status_c_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        loan_count AS c_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    WHERE 
        status = 'C'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        SUM(loan_count) AS total_count
    FROM 
        loan_counts
    GROUP BY 
        region, loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    tc.region,
    tc.loan_size_category,
    COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) AS c_count,
    tc.total_count,
    (COALESCE(sc.c_count, 0) * 100.0 / tc.total_count) AS c_percentage
FROM 
    total_counts tc
LEFT JOIN 
    status_c_counts sc ON tc.region = sc.region AND tc.loan_size_category = sc.loan_size_category;

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(loans_with_no_issues) AS overall_loans_with_no_issues,
        SUM(total_loans) AS overall_total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_data
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    (overall_loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / overall_total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_stats;

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY

            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END

        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

        loan

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE

WITH AbnormalHCT AS (
    SELECT Laboratory.ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "HCT" < 29 OR "HCT" > 52
)

ORDER BY Examination."aCL IgA" DESC

sql:
SELECT 
    element1, 
    element2, 
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS element1, 
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element  -- To avoid duplicate pairs like (H, O) and (O, H)
)
GROUP BY 
    element1, 
    element2
ORDER BY 
    count DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    element1, 
    element2, 
    SUM(combination_count) AS total_combination_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
) subquery
GROUP BY 
    element1, element2
ORDER BY 
    total_combination_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH ElementCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
)
SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    element1,
    element2,
    combination_count
FROM 
    ElementCombinations
WHERE 
    rn = 1;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
    QUALIFY 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    MostCommonCombinations mcc ON a1.molecule_id = mcc.molecule_id 
        AND a1.element = mcc.element1 
        AND a2.element = mcc.element2;

    atom_count
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
ORDER BY atom_count DESC

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;
